eligibility.quote: Issue #276 gives a reproducer ("ros2 run demo_nodes_cpp talker" in one terminal; "sudo timedatectl set-ntp no" and "sudo date -s @`date +%s | xargs -I@ echo @-5 | bc`" in another), an strace showing "FUTEX_WAIT_BITSET_PRIVATE|FUTEX_CLOCK_REALTIME", and a gdb stack through "dds_waitset_wait_impl ... rmw_wait () from ... librmw_cyclonedds_cpp.so". Cyclone maintainer confirmed: "the implementation of the timeout in `rmw_wait` (which is simply passed on to Cyclone's `dds_waitset_wait`) is using the wall clock rather than a monotonic clock." https://github.com/ros2/rmw_cyclonedds/issues/276

failed_conditions.quote: Just to be sure: the issue you're running into is that implementation of the timeout in `rmw_wait` (which is simply passed on to Cyclone's `dds_waitset_wait`) is using the wall clock rather than a monotonic clock. Correct?

loudness.quote: The delay is observed only as missing timer output and in strace/gdb, with no diagnostic from any tool: "once system time jumps back in 5 seconds, timer will be in sleep in 5 more seconds."

resolution.quote: cyclonedds PR #2255 body: "The main commit in this PR allows blocking with timeouts based on a monotonic clock rather than the system clock. This should address the various problems with time jumps people have been facing. I haven't actually tested it with time jumps yet because of some practicalities" and "Fixes #1995 https://github.com/ros2/rmw_cyclonedds/issues/276". Merged 2025-08-05; no report in the sources shows rmw_cyclonedds running with the fixed Cyclone across a time jump.

notes: Adjudicated case C3-055: fully agrees with specification eligibility (E1-E4 step 6), failed conditions, loudness (silent_documented), and resolution status (recommended).
